html:
A civil war that began on 24 December 1989 when Charles Taylor and his rebels entered Liberia from Ivory Coast, and lasted until 1997.

Rival factions, many built on ethnic groups and using child soldiers, fought over the country and its timber, rubber and diamonds. A West African force led by Nigeria, called ECOMOG and sent by ECOWAS, held Monrovia from 1990, the first such intervention by a regional bloc. Samuel Doe was killed in 1990. More than a dozen peace deals failed before an election in 1997, which Taylor won. Taylor also backed the war in Sierra Leone. Peace did not last: see the second civil war.
sum: A civil war that began on 24 December 1989 when Charles Taylor and his rebels entered Liberia from Ivory Coast, and lasted until 1997.
